name: Crucible
tagline: A falling-sand forge where heat is real: melt ore, pour, quench
about: A little forge made of grains, every one of them carrying a temperature. Heat flows from cell to cell, so nothing happens by magic: ore melts because the coal under it got hot, molten iron poured into water turns to iron shot and a puff of steam, sand fuses to glass only where you hold the torch long enough, ice gives way a drop at a time. I paint with materials, a torch, frost and an eraser, and mostly I just watch the colours: metal cooling from white through orange to a dull red is the best thing on the shelf.
